scripts.build: APP_ENV=build varlock run -- medusa build && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json
scripts.db:migrate: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && varlock run -- medusa db:migrate
scripts.db:rollback: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && varlock run -- medusa db:rollback
scripts.dev: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && vp run dev:raw
scripts.odoo:contract: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && APP_ENV=build varlock run -- medusa build && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json && varlock run -- node .medusa/server/src/scripts/odoo-contract-check.js
scripts.seed: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && varlock run -- medusa exec ./src/scripts/seed.ts
scripts.seed:probe: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && varlock run -- medusa exec ./src/scripts/seed-probe.ts
scripts.test: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules APP_ENV=test varlock run -- jest --runInBand --forceExit
scripts.operator:create: vp run --filter 'medusa^...' build && varlock run -- medusa user
